blurb: Guests rent boats to operate on Lake Ray Hubbard. Rentals require a valid driver's license and, if born after August 31, 1993, a Texas Boater Education Certificate. Safety rules include wearing US Coast Guard approved personal flotation devices at all times and no alcohol or drug use while operating vessels.
extraNote: All reservations are non-refundable unless Trip Protection is purchased at booking · With Trip Protection, cancel up to 24 hours in advance for full rental credit · No refund, credit, or rescheduling without Trip Protection · No-shows or arriving 1 hour late results in forfeiture of reservation and payment · Next Wave Boat Rentals may cancel for inclement weather or other issues and may issue rental credit at their discretion · No refunds or credits for unfavorable but not dangerous weather conditions · Gift card sales are final and non-refundable. · With Trip Protection: Cancel up to 24 hours before your rental start time to receive a full refund in the form of a rental credit (gift card).

checkin: Please arrive 30 minutes early for check in and bring the credit card used to reserve and your driver's license. Operators of Next Wave Boat Rental vessels must be at least 21 years of age. By law a TEXAS BOATER SAFETY CERTIFICATE is REQUIRED for anyone born on OR after September 1st, 1993 by the Texas Parks and Wildlife.
cancellation: With Trip Protection: Cancel up to 24 hours before your rental start time to receive a full refund in the form of a rental credit (gift card). Without Trip Protection: All sales are final. No refunds or credits will be issued. No-Shows: Reservations will be forfeited with no refund or credit. Arriving more than 1 hour past your scheduled start time without notice is considered a no-show.
